fx_snapshot.source_label: BSP Philippine peso per US dollar, 23 September 2026

electronics_recovery.rationale: A conservative shared P/B screening band for export electronics with rounded USD per-share facts, cyclical cash flows, and unresolved common claims. The numerical band reuses the prior lower-risk-adjusted screening range; it is not peer-calibrated.

cyclical_industrial.rationale: A shared P/B screening band for manufacturing and industrial supply while segment cash flows, reinvestment, and capital claims are unreconciled. The numerical band reuses the reviewed Batch 9 cyclical operating screen; it is not peer-calibrated.

source.label: IMI FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

IMI.metric_label: 1H2026 PSE-reported USD book value per share translated to PHP
IMI.route_reason: Operating electronics cash flows and reinvestment require FCFF; a translated P/B range is a separate finite screen.
IMI.intrinsic_blocker: Reviewed customer and geography cash flows, margins, working capital, capex, leases, debt, and terminal economics are incomplete.
IMI.source_warning: PSE USD book value per share is rounded to cents before PHP conversion; this screen inherits material rounding and FX sensitivity.

TECH.metric_label: 1H2026 PSE-reported USD book value per share translated to PHP
TECH.route_reason: Semiconductor and wireless businesses require attributable SOTP after parent capital claims; a translated P/B range is a separate screen.
TECH.intrinsic_blocker: Business-component values, preferred-share claims, debt, minority interests, dilution, and parent-only cash flows are not reconciled.

LFM.subsector: Flour milling, distribution, and property leasing

source.label: LFM FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

normalization.formula: reported PHP book value per share

LFM.route_reason: Flour milling and property interests need separately reviewed SOTP values; P/B is a finite screen while distribution economics are reset.
LFM.intrinsic_blocker: Recurring flour economics after the July distribution shift, property values, non-operating gains, debt, and common claims are not reconciled.
LFM.source_warning: LFM assumed direct distribution after the 30 June report. FY2025 reported attributable income exceeded gross revenue and should not be extrapolated as recurring earnings.
